COLLABORATION AT THE CORE OF OUR PRACTICE

A practical perspective,
backed by experience.

P S B & Associates LLP was established in 2013 by founding partners CA Pavan S. Toshniwal and CA Bharadwaj R. Mandhane. CA Sagar Sahebrao Nikam is the third member of the partner team.

The firm provides services to clients in India and abroad. Our team of chartered accountants and other professionals works under partner guidance across assurance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, tax planning, financial planning, company formation, business setup and financing.

With offices in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and Hingoli, our practice serves Indian and multinational corporates, banking and financial institutions, startups, high-net-worth individuals, executives and expatriates.
